# PantherSplits

> PantherSplits is a free, no-signup web app for splitting group expenses — trips, flatmates, dinners, office kitties and events. It runs entirely in the browser (no account, no server storage), works out the fewest payments needed to settle up, and shares the result on WhatsApp or as a link. Amounts are in Indian rupees (₹).

Site: https://panthersplits.com/

## Modes

- **Split (pay as you go):** each expense records who paid and who it was for. Items shared by only some people are divided only among them. Each person's balance is what they paid minus their share, and the app suggests the fewest payments to even things out.
- **Shared Pot (chip in first, also called a kitty or common fund):** everyone contributes a set amount up front (for example ₹500 each), one person holds the pot and pays for things, and at the end the app reconciles it. If money is left over, the holder refunds people based on what each actually used; if the pot was overspent, people top up the holder. Contributions can differ per person.

## Features

- Expenses are grouped by who shared them (for example "Everyone except Vijay — ₹900, ₹300 each").
- Tapping a person's balance shows the item-by-item breakdown of their share.
- Settlement reads as plain sentences ("Dhuri pays Gk ₹350") and each payment can be ticked as paid.
- "New split" can keep the same people and clear expenses, with undo — useful for flatmates and regular groups.
- WhatsApp summary, copyable share link, and save/import as a JSON file.

## Worked examples

- Split: Asha pays ₹900 for a cab for Asha, Ben and Chetan; Ben pays ₹300 for snacks for Ben and Chetan. Result: Ben pays Asha ₹150 and Chetan pays Asha ₹450.
- Shared Pot: four friends put in ₹500 each and Raj holds the pot. They spend ₹1,600 on shared items, so Raj refunds ₹100 to each of the other three. Had they spent ₹2,400, each of the other three would pay Raj ₹100.

## Key facts

- Price: free. No account, signup, subscription or app install.
- Privacy: data is stored only in the user's browser (localStorage). Share links carry the project inside the URL itself.
- Platforms: any modern web browser on phone, tablet or computer. Requires JavaScript.
- Limits: one split at a time per browser; rupees only; equal split within each expense (unequal shares can be entered as separate expenses).
